listing_info.listing_name: Hidden 4BR-3 bath gem with lake views
listing_info.description:
Escape to this delightful house in picturesque Gilford. This charming property features 4 bedrooms, including 2 king, 1 bunks, and 1 full bed. With 3 bathrooms offering amenities like a jetted bathtub and shower, guests will feel pampered during their stay. Our place will help you feel at home while you're traveling in Gilford. This well located home will help you and your families create a lifetime of memories. This house sits just feet away from Lake Winnipesauke.

The space
The property is on the private peninsula of Varney point. The house comes with 4BR 3 full baths. The master is a king size bed with master bath. On the other side of the house, it comes with a in-law suite. with full bath and sitting area with microwave and fridge. One of the other common bedrooms come with a queen size bed and the other comes with a bunkbed. Livingroom is large and open to the dining room and kitchen. The front porch which faces the lake has a great relaxing sitting area enough for 10 people.

Guest access
The entire house is available to enjoy.

Other things to note
The House is centrally located in the heart of Lake Winnipesaukee. There are many restaurants just minutes from the location and some just walking distance. The Bank of New Hampshire Pavillion is also in walking distance. About 20/25 mins. The Laconia Airport is also just a 5min ride. You can also access the lake in just a 1 min walk from the house. You can also access Gilford beach in just a 10min walk. Ellacoya state park is just a 4 min drive from the house. Gunstock Mountain is just a 10min ride. There are so many activities so close to this house, it really is a great location to enjoy this great area.

listing_info.listing_name: Beautiful Log Cabin on Belleau Lake -2900 sqft!
Spacious Belleau Lake House Amongst the Trees
listing_info.description:
You and your family & friends will feel right at home in this spacious custom built home in the tall trees across the street from beautiful Belleau Lake. There are three levels of living space, making it a great destination for small or mid sized groups or families looking to share a vacation without compromising privacy. It is also perfectly cozy for a couple. Enjoy the peacefulness of being high amongst the trees with the glow of the lake and shared sandy beach just steps away.

The space
The first level features double doors that bring you into the family room, complete with pool/ping pong table, darts, and warm comfy sofas and chairs to watch TV or your favorite internet-based programming along with stereo sound and closets full of classic VHS. Just off the family room is a full bathroom, as well as a bedroom with a full size bed. Additionally, the laundry room with washer and dryer are located on this level.

Going upstairs to the second level, you'll enter the sun-drenched living room with 2 stories of windows facing Belleau Lake and two plush recliner couches. Also on this level is the fully-equipped kitchen with everything a gourmet cook would need to prepare sumptuous meals for the whole gang (except the food). For those cool nights, there's a cozy woodstove with firewood provided and the house is fully heated and insulated for winter enjoyment. There's room for eight at the dining room table, along with several stools at the breakfast bar. Just off the dining area is a deck with a gas grill and umbrella'ed picnic table for outdoor dining. This deck leads down to the first level deck that measures 36'x9' with plenty of lounge chairs. Walk down the stairs towards a tiki torch lit path to the firepit area just below the house with a horse shoe pit and cornhole!

Off the living room are two spacious bedrooms with full and queen size beds and ceiling fans. In addition, there is a full bath located just outside the bedrooms. All linens and towels are provided.

Also off the living room, there's an open staircase that leads to the loft area which overlooks the living room and catches all that light from the 2 stories of windows, and where you can enjoy times of solitude on the pull-out couch. And off the loft is another bedroom with two full size beds.

For outdoor activities, Vachon Beach (private to our lake association) is a five minute walk just down the road, and where we have a canoe and kayak ready for your enjoyment on the lake. If golf is your game, Province Lake Golf Course is less than five minutes away. There are several great restaurants within a mile, including two great general stores.

Not far from here are all the activities you can imagine. From historic Portland to North Conway and Lake Winnipesaukee, this vacation home is the perfect jumping off point for all that New Hampshire and Maine have to offer.

And if the power ever goes out, don't worry. There's a whole house generator that will kick in within 10 seconds, so you'll never be without power. Closets full of movies, games & books await!

Other things to note
While this is a great home for gathering with family and friends, it is also part of a close knit, peaceful neighborhood so we can not accommodate renters looking for a party house. Noise and outdoor activities must be kept to a minimum after 10 pm and we ask that guests be cognizant of lights being on too brightly after dark (use the dimmers please). We value and respect our neighbors and can not tolerate renters who do not do the same.

listing_info.listing_name: Lakefront Home with private dock - Smoke Free
listing_info.description:
Great East Lodge (ais a waterfront retreat perfect for a large family or a group of friends. The living room has a 46” flat screen TV/DVD while the kitchen is updated with stainless steel appliances. Full size washer/dryer are available for use during your stay.
Two master bedrooms each have a queen bed, a third bedroom has two full size beds and the fourth has two sets of bunk beds. The Lodge has a private waterfront patio with dining area where you can enjoy the sunsets

The space
Your time can be as active or relaxed as you like. Just outside your private home is a host of activities shared with the four cottages that comprise the property. You can paddle the 7 kayaks or 3 SUPs (standup paddle boards), swim, fish or play basketball, volleyball, badminton, bean bag toss or pickle ball. The boathouse offers ping pong, pool, and a great place to relax with a book, play board games or work on a puzzle. From the mid 40's to the late 60's, The Lodge was part of a YMCA Summer Camp and retains some of the charm of that era .... yet with today's modern conveniences.

Other things to note
We have a pontoon boat and a Boston Whaler so we are always looking for an excuse to take a boat ride. You are welcome to relax on the pontoon with us or ..... ski or tube behind the Whaler.

listing_info.listing_name: Lake Winnipesaukee True Island Property, sleeps 10
listing_info.description:
Looking for fresh air, no cars and very limited people? We have two cottages set on 30 acres on an island on Lake Winnipesaukee, NH.

This is a true island property accessible only by boat. Approximately 5 acres is fenced, so the only people you will have contact with are those you wish to be with. This vacation property features a three bedroom home and an additional two bedroom home. There is an option to rent just one cottage, please contact for details.

NH License #040433

The space
There is a private dock capable of handling a 35 foot boat, a waterfront sun deck with newer 8 person hot tub surrounded by privacy screening, a gym with newer treadmill, bow flex, elliptical, rowing machine, weights and other equipment, in addition to a private clay tennis court with ball thrower and a pickleball court. There is a cutting garden for your decorative skills along with an herb garden to improve your culinary skills. There is shore side free parking for 2 cars. Both homes have electric heat and the three bedroom house has a central fireplace and air circulator. You have access to a gas grill on your deck. Three of the five bedrooms have TV's.

*Waiver of liability to be signed upon arrival to the property*

Guest access
Gym, private clay tennis court & laundry is shared with owner and his personal guest(s).

Other things to note
*Waiver of liability to be signed upon arrival to the property*

We accept rentals from Saturday to Saturday.

There is wifi, but can be very spotty given this home is on an island. Some guests will use cell phone hot spots for better service.

In the three bedroom home there are two under counter fridges and a freezer. In the two bedroom home there is a full sized side by side refrigerator/freezer and a full size range.

All Seasons Getaway!   Perfect for leaf peeping, skiing, or enjoying the lake.  Our 4 bedroom home on Lake Winnipesaukee offers breathtaking views from both inside and out.   2  living rooms,  dinning area,  and wide open kitchen with large island and bar provide the perfect relaxation retreat - enjoy family meals, play games or relax in front of the electric log fireplace to watch tv.

listing_info.listing_name: Family Vacation Compound on Lake Winnipesaukee
listing_info.description: Spectacular family compound on 7 acres with 300+ feet of Lake Winnipesaukee shorefront. Main house, Guest House, Boathouse, Cove House, and garage with game room are all part of the package. Beautiful lake and mountain views, close to golf course and minutes to town of Wolfeboro.  Ideal for multi-generational vacation.

listing_info.listing_name: Mountain & lake house on private 2+ acres!
listing_info.description:
Bring the whole family to our large yet super cozy home away from home in Gunstock Acres at Lake Winnipesaukee! The property includes tons of outdoor space for exploring or hanging out, plus two levels of indoor living space perfect for multi-family gatherings or a relaxing weekend away with friends. Seeing a concert at Bank of NH Pavilion (formerly known as Meadowbrook)? Stay here and be just 5 mins away!

The space
Plenty of outdoor space and two levels of indoor living space perfect for multi-family gatherings. 2 full baths (one on each floor) with bedroom setups as follows:
-queen
-queen
-twin x4 plus toddler bed
-futon bed (side by side twins)

Guest access
Guests may access the entire space except for the attached garage, which is owner’s storage.

Other things to note
Brand new oversized rear deck in progress ready for summer 2026! Also, new A/C mini splits on both levels, including upstairs bedrooms. Stay cool and comfy inside this summer!
